text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Trainer! There's actually a restaurant
I've wanted to check out
for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: If we win today's race, let's have a victory celebration there!
choice_data_list: Are you already thinking about what happens after you win?
You're already thinking about what comes after winning, huh.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Because our victory today was already decided from the start!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't deliver results the other day.
However, that was only true for that single race."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I have no doubt in my mind that I didn't do
anything wrong, that my run was completely right!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
We just need to use this defeat as fuel to win everything from now on.
The 'Voice of Destiny' says so too!
choice_data_list: Then I'll reserve the best course for us.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's great!
That's my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! Today's meal is gonna
turn out super delicious!
